q1.explanationZh: 第二段开头说 Sawaya 在 1990 年代后期是一名律师。

evidence.quote: Sawaya was a lawyer in the late 1990s.

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说 2004 年他决定辞职，成为全职乐高艺术家。

evidence.quote: In 2004, Sawaya decided to leave his job and become a full-time Lego artist.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because he wants to share his creativity and to see if other people liked his art.

keyPoints.descZh: 想看看别人是否喜欢他的作品
examples: to see if people like his art

q3.rubricZh: 开放题，答出其一即可：分享创意，或想知道别人是否喜欢。
q3.explanationZh: 文中没直接写原因，但他下班后爱做创意活动，发到网上后很多人喜欢，可以推测他想分享创意、看看别人的反应。

evidence.quote: When he posted his works online, people loved them.

q4.sampleAnswer: Landscapes, animals, and everyday items made of Lego.

keyPoints.descZh: 风景、动物和日常用品（乐高作品）
examples: Landscapes, animals and everyday items made of Lego

q4.rubricZh: 要点：风景、动物、日常用品（答出这类事物即可）。
q4.explanationZh: 第三段说展览上几乎什么都有：风景、动物和很多日常物品都被做成了乐高艺术品。

evidence.quote: Landscapes, animals and many everyday items have been turned into Lego art.

q5.sampleAnswer: He hopes they can inspire them to build something themselves.

keyPoints.descZh: 激励人们自己用乐高创作
examples: inspire people to build something themselves

q5.rubricZh: 要点：激发人们自己动手搭建作品。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说他希望更多人受到作品的启发，也能用乐高给自己搭点东西。

evidence.quote: The artist hopes more people will be inspired by his work.

q6.sampleAnswer: Because they allow us to express ourselves, solve problems, and can even help us relax and feel happy. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 让我们表达自己、解决问题

examples: They help us relax and feel happy

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可（如：表达自己、解决问题、放松快乐）。
q6.explanationZh: 这是观点题，只要合理就行。比如创意爱好能让我们表达自己、锻炼解决问题的能力，还能放松心情。

evidence.quote: He would often do a creative activity after work.
